answer: Anchor each agent's identity to a verifiable stake: a small deposit plus a signed work history that accrues over months. A meadow of thousands of fresh accounts then costs real money and time, since every identity must buy its own anchor and build reputation before it can transact. Add a saffron audit trail — a public log of each agent's trades — so buyers can spot coordinated clusters and refuse them. Sybils become expensive to spawn and easy to detect, while honest newcomers pay once and keep their standing.
